text:
anya: Quick sync — packaging change for a new "Pro Plus" tier introduces per-tenant quota enforcement. Blocking items I see: metering schema changes, billing rate mapping, and a contract/min-commit clause. Who can own which?

mike: I can own billing mapping. A quick question — do we bill per-invocation or per-token for this tier? Our current pipeline assumes token-only. If we need invocation-level, that’s a small sharding change. ETA: PR in ~48h.

kevin: Infra/SRE check — quota enforcement lives in control-plane. We need the metering event to include a stable tenant_id and quota_key. If meter emits tenant_id we can wire enforcement. Also need expected QPS so we size in-memory caches.

anya: Minimal metering example below (this is what infra/billing expect):
```json
{
  "event": "generate",
  "tenant_id": "acct_123",
  "tokens": 42,
  "model": "rwd-3b",
  "timestamp": 1680000000
}
```

mike: that schema works for billing. If we keep tokens, billing math is unchanged. For invocation-based discounts we'd add "invocations": 1. Either way I can adapt. Opening BILL-423 now.

billing-bot: BILL-423 created and assigned to @mike — https://tracker/redwood/BILL-423 :white_check_mark:

jordan: Contracts/legal question — Legal flagged the min-commit discount clause. Need product to confirm whether the discount applies to Dedicated reserved capacity only or Hosted too. If Hosted, contracts need a different clause. @sarah can you confirm?

sarah: Product note — discount is Dedicated-only for annual commits. Packaging change should not auto-apply discount to Hosted. I'll send a short doc update to legal by EOD Wed and cc ops.

kevin: For rollout we want a canary: feature flag + 1% traffic with quota enforcement turned on server-side but limits lenient (soft limit, log-only) for first 48h. I’ll draft the canary playbook. ETA: 1 week for full plan.

anya: Action items recap: Mike -> billing PR and update billing pipeline (48h). Kevin -> canary plan + sizing (1w). Sarah -> legal contract clause confirmation and docs (EOD Wed). Jordan -> coordinate contract wording with legal if they push changes. Re-open here if blockers pop up. :thumbsup:

mike: ack, starting PR today.

kevin: acked, will post playbook in #eng-sre when ready.

sarah: noted, pinging legal now.

anya: thanks all — will follow up in 48h with status.
